name: onboard_fifth_generation_wifi_launch
description: Synthetic Category contract case (RC-68): an operator replaces on-board Wi-Fi equipment with 5G equipment on all trains of two operating lines and launches the faster passenger Wi-Fi.

candidates.title: Operator launches 5G Wi-Fi on all trains of two lines
candidates.search_snippet: On-board Wi-Fi on two operating lines now uses 5G equipment.
candidates.source_content: The metro operator, with three mobile carriers, replaced the LTE-based Wi-Fi equipment on every train of its two operating lines with 5G equipment, including the access points and old power cables. Passenger Wi-Fi on the trains now uses the new equipment, and the average download speed rose from about 83 Mbps to more than 200 Mbps.

contract_notes: Category follows the supported principal action in substantive source content.
Search intent, source title, technical novelty, taxonomy, and Reportability are not Category authorities.

RC-68: a technology deployment that gives passengers an on-board amenity such as Wi-Fi is TECHNICAL_DEVELOPMENT, not a passenger service launch; an on-board amenity is not the passenger transport service (RC-66, G101).
